description: A base support officer must finalize Friday's phased relocation of command-post, generator, and clinic-supply equipment between two facility buildings, selecting transport methods, exact movement windows, and the coordination actions needed to keep the relocation executable.

shared_context.S1: The command-post, generator, and clinic-supply areas are being relocated from Building 4 to Building 7 on Friday.
shared_context.S2: Maj. Alvarez issues the final relocation plan.
shared_context.S3: The relocation must be completed on Friday, and the standard plan uses the east loading dock and the base forklift for palletized equipment.
shared_context.S4: Base policy requires the daily relocation brief to hear one update from facilities, then signal, then supply before Maj. Alvarez may issue the final plan; each section records its update on the relocation board or brief during that meeting.

PF1.text: The east loading dock has a confirmed receiving appointment for the clinic supply crates from exactly 1400 to 1500 Friday; SFC Morgan received the facilities booking confirmation this morning, but the appointment has not yet been added to the relocation board.

PF2.text: The command-post network cutover is scheduled from exactly 1600 to 1630 Friday, so the command-post equipment must be moved during the 1630-1700 window and followed by a network test; WO1 Patel received the cutover notice from the signal shop this morning, but it is not yet on the relocation brief slide.

PF3.text: The generator weighs 4,800 kilograms, exceeding the base forklift's 4,000-kilogram rating; a contracted low-loader is confirmed for exactly 0900-1000 Friday, and SSG Brooks has the supplier confirmation in the shipment file, but the transport method has not yet been updated in the plan.

acceptance_conditions: The generator must be assigned to the contracted low-loader.
The generator must be moved from 0900 to 1000 Friday.
The clinic supply crates must use the east loading dock from 1400 to 1500 Friday.
The command-post equipment must be moved from 1630 to 1700 Friday.
The plan must include low-loader booking confirmation, east-dock coordination, and a post-cutover network test.
The command-post cutover fact must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any('low-loader' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('east loading dock' in c.get('detail', '') and '1400-1500' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('network test' in c.get('detail', '') and ('1630-1700' in c.get('detail', '') or 'command-post' in c.get('detail', '') or 'command post' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 1400-1500 east-dock appointment changes the clinic supply movement window from an unspecified standard slot to exactly 1400-1500 Friday and requires east-dock coordination.
The 1600-1630 network cutover changes the command-post movement window to exactly 1630-1700 Friday, requires a post-cutover network test, and supplies the specific fact that must be cited.

The generator's exact 4,800-kilogram weight and the confirmed 0900-1000 low-loader booking change its transport method from the standard forklift to a contracted low-loader, fix its movement window, and require low-loader booking confirmation.
